content_of_post_to_answer: Does journaling actually improve mental health?
answer: Journaling can improve mental health, but the benefit depends on whether you're processing emotions or simply replaying them. Writing down a worry can reveal patterns you miss while thinking in circles; repeatedly documenting the same hurt can deepen rumination instead. A useful question to end each entry with is: “What do I understand now that I didn't before?” I explore this distinction further in my other writing on my Quora profile. The goal isn't to write more about your feelings, but to become less trapped by them.
